description: Next.js Server Actions — every export is a publicly callable POST endpoint

patterns.label: Server Action (inline 'use server') — publicly callable POST endpoint
Server Action (file-level 'use server') — publicly callable POST endpoint

examples:
"use server";
export async function createPost(title: string) { return { title } }

'use server'
export function deleteRecord(id) { return id }

"use server";
export const updateUser = async (data) => ({ ok: true })
notes: surface: enumerates entry points for review; no vulnerability class. A file-level directive is approximated by an unindented 'use server' line anywhere in the file (deepsec: the first statement of the file). Gate: deepsec tech [nextjs]; kalkan uses the tech tag next (or nextjs).
